newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Crane says pleased with results.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Crane says pleased with results.

text.p: Metal products manufacturer and plumbing products supplier G.E. Crane Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was encouraged by its 30 percent increase in net profit for the half year to December 30.
"We have continued to make good progress and are encouraged by this very solid result achieved against the backdrop of a depressed housing industry," managing director John Ingram said.
Crane earlier reported a net profit of A$13.6 million for half year, up from A$10.5 million a year earlier.
Sales rose to A$486 million form A$444 million, aided by acquisitions.
"It was particularly pleasing that both our metals manufacturing and plumbing supplies distribution streams contributed to the improvement," Ingram said.
He said the integration of two recent acquisitions, Alumex and Raymor, into their respective divisions were major factors behind the improvement.

Ingram said that while the Australian building environment continued to show no clear signs of improvement, the company would continue to strive to deliver increased shareholder value by continuing to drive down costs, extracting synergies and increasing efficiencies in all divisions.
"At the same time, we will continue to seek further appropriate growth opportunities," he said.
